import cv2, numpy as np
img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0054.png')
# let's find all pixels of the sofa
# it has blue-gray color
diff = np.abs(img[:, :, 0].astype(int) - 110) + np.abs(img[:, :, 1].astype(int) - 95) + np.abs(img[:, :, 2].astype(int) - 90)
# sofa pixels have diff < 30
ys, xs = np.where(diff < 25)
print('Sofa pixels count:', len(ys))
print('u range:', xs.min(), xs.max())
print('v range:', ys.min(), ys.max())

# print bottom-most pixel for each column
bottom_profile = {}
for x in range(xs.min(), xs.max()+1):
    col_ys = ys[xs == x]
    if len(col_ys) > 0:
        bottom_profile[x] = col_ys.max()

# let's print selected columns
for x in range(xs.min(), xs.max()+1, 20):
    print(f'x={x}, bottom_v={bottom_profile[x]}')
"
